message.content:
- Horizontal overflow: Calendar grid exceeds viewport width (375px).  
- Calendar grid fitting: Week view grid doesn’t adapt to mobile width, causing overflow.  
- Day cells truncated: Time slots/labels cut off due to narrow viewport.  
- Action button size: Buttons (e.g., Day/Week/Month toggles) too small for touch.  
- Sticky header overlap: Header (navigation, filters) may cover top calendar content.  
- Sidebar/nav: Fixed sidebar (if present) may not collapse, wasting space.
